notes.title: 1.2.7 2020 July Patriotic Update
notes.notes:
1.2.7 2020 July Patriotic Update

Show your colors this Independence / Canada Day with the flashy new Red White and Blue or the stylishly new Red and White, both unlocked with the new Patriotic Achievement.

Not All Equal game mode weapon now reverts back to the starting weapon once your current powerup finishes instead of the default laser.

June Leaderboard reset, congratulations to Mith for there first Leaderboard win.

notes.title: 1.2.6 2020 Donut Update
notes.notes:
1.2.6 2020 Donut Update

Everyone likes Donuts right? New Donut shaped level added and ready to be unlocked.  With the no go zone in the center, you can still shoot each other but makes closing that gap a little harder.  

Trials leaderboard reset, congrats to Eviscerator MK2™ for the May win!!

notes.title: 1.2.5 2020 Winners Board Update
notes.notes:
1.2.5 2020 Winners Board Update

Yearly Winners board added so players can proudly show off there achievements for the year.

April Leaderboard reset, Big congrats to Amber Nebula for winning there April spot on the board

Cheers all. Happy Botting and stay safe!

notes.title: 1.2.04 April Easter Update
notes.notes:
New Easter themed update comes fresh with a new egg hunt game mode and a new bunny themed Bot! 

The Hunt, small egg shaped packages appear randomly on the map, collect them for extra scrap and slight stat boosts: Yellow for speed, red for increased damage and green for instant health.

Long Ears, new bot available to unlock for Trials or Coop play.

Reworked unlock prices.

March Leaderboard reset, Big congrats to derekx8x and West for the first play tie with 238. Intense!

notes.title: 1.2.3 March Klaw Update
notes.notes:
Completely revamped unlock system.  Players now collect scrap while playing, gathering 1.5x the scraps via leaderboard play and even more while playing with friends, more players, more scrap!  Scrap is used to unlock steam achievements, which give players access to new skins, levels and bots.

New Bot, the Klaw! Small but nimble.

New Skin, Lapis.

And as always, general bug fixes and game tweeks as well as Leaderboard reset.

notes.title: 1.2.02 Junkyard February Update
notes.notes:
1.2.02 Junkyard February Update

The Trials : February leaderboard reset.  Prize available for the 1st place leaderboard winner this month.  If this goes well, we will continue each month!  Canada and USA only for now, shipping included. Address will need to be provided, follow @Pascalcleroux or @Bots_the_game for details and updates.

New Level : Junkyard is now available for everyone for multiplayer and Trials play. Giant never before seen Bots litter the level, hindering line of sight and maneuverability.

General Bug Fixing and game updates.

notes.title: 1.2 Update : Leaderboard / AI Bots
notes.notes:
Happy January everyone! 

I'm still working on the BIG campaign update but I decided to add a smaller update to keep things interesting till then.

1.2 Comes with a new Leaderboard mode, AI Bots to add when you want to add more competition and a few minor updates / tweaks. 

As always, I would love to hear what you all think / would love to see in this coop arcade mech shooter so please do not hesitate to let me know :D 

Cheers and thank you so much for the constant support, you're all incredible!

Pascal
